scope: Five ESPN-verified 2021–2025 franchise-linked champions plus three source-verified 2014/2016/2017 legacy season champions without cross-era franchise attribution. The 2015 final result has disputed semifinal progression and is not credited.

rules.marker: One trophy for a verified title-winning franchise, displaying years and a title count when needed.
rules.historical_aliases: Resolve by (season, ESPN source league ID, ESPN team ID), then anonymous permanent franchise ID.
rules.unknown_titles: No trophy for unverified seasons or placement games; historic aliases show trophies only for the season they won.
rules.owner_privacy: Store no owner or manager identifiers.
rules.legacy_season_markers: 2014, 2016 and 2017 display a trophy only on the archived season's ESPN champion team ID; no current-season or cross-era franchise trophy is granted until owner identity is separately confirmed.
rules.disputed_2015: ESPN's recorded 2015 final winner is disclosed textually only, because semifinal advancement conflicts with the reported finalists. No trophy, championship count or modern attribution.
